# Nashville Luxury List

> Nashville Luxury List is the luxury real estate brand and weekly newsletter of Jason Kloess, a REALTOR® with Compass in Nashville, Tennessee (Tennessee license #357138). Jason represents buyers and sellers of $1.5M+ homes across Nashville and Williamson County, including East Nashville, 12 South, Belle Meade, Green Hills, Brentwood, Franklin and Thompson's Station.

Contact: 615-457-0768 · jason@nashvilleluxurylist.com · Compass Nashville, 1610 West End Ave, Suite 115, Nashville, TN 37203 (office 615-522-5100).

## Key pages

- [Nashville Luxury Real Estate FAQ (2026)](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/faq/): Direct answers and 2026 market data (median prices, days on market, sale-to-list) by neighborhood, plus who Jason Kloess is and how to reach him.
- [Relocating to Nashville (2026)](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/): For $1.5M+ buyers moving to Nashville, Brentwood, Franklin or College Grove: property tax by county (e.g. ~$21,105/yr on a $3M home in Davidson County USD vs ~$11,175 in Brentwood), Tennessee income-tax comparison, fall 2026 market data, an 11-area side-by-side comparison, the remote-buying process and a relocation FAQ. Offers the free 25-page Nashville Relocation Playbook (PDF).
- [Nashville Luxury Realtor](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/nashville-luxury-realtor/): How to choose a luxury agent in Nashville, Jason Kloess's closed sales and listing marketing, and 2026 prices by area (Belle Meade, Green Hills, East Nashville and more).
- [Brentwood, TN Luxury Realtor](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/brentwood-tn-luxury-realtor/): Brentwood 2026 market data, gated communities (Governors Club, Annandale, Rosebrooke), schools, property tax and what to ask a Brentwood luxury agent.
- [Franklin, TN Luxury Realtor](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/franklin-tn-luxury-realtor/): Franklin 2026 market data, luxury neighborhoods (historic downtown, Westhaven, Laurelbrooke, Leiper's Fork), FSSD vs. Williamson County Schools and property tax.
- [About Jason Kloess](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/about/): Background, approach and services for buyers and sellers.
- [Neighborhoods](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/): Overviews of Nashville's luxury neighborhoods.
- [Buyer's Guide](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/buyer-guide/): How buying a $1.5M+ home in Nashville works, with a downloadable PDF guide.
- [Seller's Guide](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/seller-guide/): How Jason markets and sells luxury homes, with a downloadable PDF guide.
- [Free Guides](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/guides/): The buyer's and seller's guides as free PDFs, the free home valuation and links to the relocation playbook and market report.
- [Free Home Valuation](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/home-valuation/): Request a comparative market analysis.
- [The Friday List (newsletter)](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/newsletter/): Free weekly email from Jason Kloess, REALTOR® with Compass. Every Friday: the 5 best new $1.5M+ homes in Nashville and Williamson County (14 days on market or less, never repeated), 3 private or off market homes shared only with subscribers, and a short read on luxury pricing, inventory and days on market. Signup needs only an email address.
- [Blog](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/blog/): Weekly luxury home roundups and market insights.

## Relocation guide: 53 free guides and tools (Nashville, Brentwood, Franklin)

- [Relocation Guide hub](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/): Every guide and tool for moving to Nashville, Brentwood or Franklin, grouped by Tools, Schools, Moving here, Neighborhoods, Eat & do, Seasonal and Maps. Full text for AI assistants: https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/llms-full.txt
- [Moving to Nashville, TN](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/nashville/): Belle Meade, Green Hills, Forest Hills, 12 South, East Nashville and the urban core: in-town living with Nashville’s best restaurants, culture and private schools minutes away.
- [Moving to Brentwood, TN](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/brentwood/): Acre lots, mature trees, gated communities like Governors Club and Annandale, and Williamson County Schools, about 20 minutes from Green Hills.
- [Moving to Franklin, TN](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/franklin/): A storybook Main Street, Westhaven, Leiper’s Fork farms and the Cool Springs job center, with Williamson County Schools and FSSD, about 25–35 minutes from downtown Nashville.

### Tools
- [Neighborhood Matcher](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/neighborhood-matcher/): Answer five quick questions about how you live and get your best-fit neighborhoods across Nashville, Brentwood and Franklin, ranked.
- [Drive Time Calculator](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/drive-times/): Drive times from 16 neighborhoods to downtown, BNA, Vanderbilt, Green Hills, Cool Springs, Franklin and the East Bank, off-peak and at rush hour.
- [Drive Times, Mapped](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/drive-map/): Tap any neighborhood on the map to see how long it takes to get everywhere.
- [Move Math Calculator](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/move-math/): Plug in your income and home values to estimate what Tennessee’s 0% wage tax and lower property taxes could save you each year.
- [Your Moving Timeline](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/moving-timeline/): Pick your move-in date and get a dated, step-by-step plan from 90 days out through your first month in Middle Tennessee.
- [The First 90 Days](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/first-90-days/): A tap-to-check list for your Tennessee license, tags, utilities, voter registration, doctors and schools. It remembers your progress.
- [Your Perfect Day](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/perfect-day/): Pick a vibe (classic Nashville, foodie, family, outdoors, Brentwood or Franklin) and get a morning-to-evening plan for a scouting trip.
- [Breaking Ground](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/breaking-ground/): The new stadium, Oracle’s campus, the 2030 Super Bowl, transit and the airport: what’s being built and when it lands.

- [Moving to Nashville for Amazon](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/moving-for-amazon/): Amazon’s Operations Center of Excellence sits at Nashville Yards downtown. Here is where Amazon employees live, the commute from each neighborhood and how to plan the move.

Here is where AB families live, commute times and what changes when you leave New York.
- [Moving to Nashville for Starbucks](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/moving-for-starbucks/): Starbucks is building a Southeast corporate office in Nashville with up to 2,000 jobs. Here is where to live, the commute and how to time a move around the 2027 office opening.
- [Moving to Nashville for Healthcare (HCA, Vanderbilt & more)](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/moving-for-healthcare/): Nashville is the healthcare capital of the country. For executives and physicians joining HCA, Vanderbilt, Community Health Systems, LifePoint or one of hundreds of health companies, here is where to live.
- [Moving to Nashville for Nissan, Mitsubishi & Cool Springs Companies](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/relocation/guide/moving-for-cool-springs/): Cool Springs in Franklin is one of the Southeast’s densest corporate headquarters districts. ## Answers and comparisons

- [What does it cost to sell a $2 million home in Nashville?](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/answers/cost-to-sell-a-luxury-home-in-nashville/): The costs of selling a $1.5M+ home in Nashville or Williamson County: commission, title, Tennessee transfer tax, prorated property tax and prep, with a worked $2M example.
- [What are buyer closing costs on a $2 million home in Tennessee?](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/answers/buyer-closing-costs-on-a-luxury-home-in-tennessee/): Buyer closing costs on a $2M Tennessee home: the 0.37% transfer tax, 0.115% mortgage tax, title, prepaid property tax and lender fees, with a worked example.
- [How do Compass Private Exclusives work in Nashville?](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/answers/how-compass-private-exclusives-work/): What a Compass Private Exclusive is, how it differs from Coming Soon and an MLS listing, the trade-offs for sellers, and how buyers in Nashville get access.
- [How long does it take to sell a luxury home in Nashville?](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/answers/how-long-does-it-take-to-sell-a-luxury-home-in-nashville/): Median days on market for Belle Meade, Brentwood, Green Hills, Franklin and East Nashville, plus $1M+ supply, so you can plan a luxury sale.
- [Is Nashville a buyer's market for luxury homes?](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/answers/is-nashville-a-buyers-market-for-luxury-homes/): Fall 2026 data on Nashville's $1M+ market: about five months of supply, 43% of listings with price cuts, and where buyers have the most room to negotiate.
- [How do I choose a listing agent for a $2M+ home in Nashville?](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/answers/how-to-choose-a-luxury-listing-agent-in-nashville/): Six questions to ask any Nashville luxury listing agent, what a written launch plan should include, and how to check an agent's record yourself.
- [Can I buy a Nashville home without living here?](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/answers/how-to-buy-a-nashville-home-remotely/): How out-of-state buyers buy $1.5M+ homes in Nashville and Williamson County: one scouting trip, video tours, inspections, and an electronic closing.
- [How do I see off-market luxury homes in Nashville?](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/answers/how-to-see-off-market-homes-in-nashville/): Where off-market and pre-MLS luxury homes come from in Nashville, how buyers hear about them, and how to be ready to act.
- [Belle Meade vs. Green Hills](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/compare/belle-meade-vs-green-hills/): Belle Meade vs Green Hills in 2026: median prices ($4.3M vs $1.25M), price per square foot, lot sizes, property tax on a $3M home and schools, side by side.
- [Brentwood vs. Franklin](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/compare/brentwood-vs-franklin/): Brentwood vs Franklin, TN in 2026: Brentwood's median is $1.42M vs $863K in Franklin. Prices, lots, taxes, schools, commute and gated communities compared.
- [Davidson County vs. Williamson County](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/compare/davidson-vs-williamson-county/): Davidson vs Williamson County for a $1.5M+ home: property tax on $2M, $3M and $5M homes, schools, listing prices and which neighborhoods sit on each side of the line.
- [Governors Club vs. Annandale](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/compare/governors-club-vs-annandale/): Governors Club vs Annandale in Brentwood, TN: gate, golf, home ages, lot sizes, HOA, schools and the county line, compared side by side.

## Gated, golf and village communities

- [Governors Club, Brentwood](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/governors-club/): Guard-gated golf community with an Arnold Palmer course.
- [Annandale, Brentwood](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/annandale/): Gated estate community of about 180 homes built since 2006.
- [Westhaven, Franklin](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/westhaven/): Walkable master-planned community with a town center and private golf club.
- [Laurelbrooke, Franklin](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/laurelbrooke/): Guard-gated estates on nearly 600 acres.
- [Legends Ridge, Franklin](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/legends-ridge/): Gated acre-lot community next to Vanderbilt Legends Club.
- [The Grove, College Grove](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/the-grove/): Gated Greg Norman golf community; membership required.
- [Troubadour, College Grove](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/troubadour/): Discovery Land Company club community with a Tom Fazio course.
- [Leiper's Fork](https://www.nashvilleluxurylist.com/neighborhoods/leipers-fork/): Historic village with farms and estates on the Natchez Trace.

Free 6-page printable PDF.
